```yaml
name: SDK CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    tags: ['v*']
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  release:
    types: [published]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  validate-version:
    name: Validate version
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event_name == 'push' && startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/')
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
      - name: Install uv
        uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/setup-uv@main
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
          enable-cache: true
      - name: Get version from pyproject.toml
        id: pyver
        run: |
          PYVER=$(python - <<'PY'
          import tomllib
          with open('pyproject.toml', 'rb') as f:
              data = tomllib.load(f)
          print(data['tool']['poetry']['version'])
          PY
          )
          echo "pyver=$PYVER" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
      - name: Get tag version
        id: tagver
        run: echo "tagver=${GITHUB_REF#refs/tags/}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
      - name: Compare versions
        run: |
          if [ "${{ steps.pyver.outputs.pyver }}" != "${{ steps.tagver.outputs.tagver }}" ]; then
            echo "Tag version ${{ steps.tagver.outputs.tagver }} does not match pyproject.toml version ${{ steps.pyver.outputs.pyver }}"
            exit 1
          fi

  sdk-ci:
    name: SDK Generation CI
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'push'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
      - name: Install uv
        uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/setup-uv@main
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
          enable-cache: true
      - name: Generate SDK
        run: uv run hatch run server:sdk-generate
      - name: Check for changes
        run: |
          git diff --exit-code
        continue-on-error: false

  python-publish:
    name: Publish Python Package
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event_name == 'release' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
    needs: validate-version
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
      - name: Install uv
        uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/setup-uv@main
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
          enable-cache: true
      - name: Build package
        run: uv run hatch build
      - name: Publish to PyPI
        uses: pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish@v1.8.2
        with:
          user: __token__
          password: ${{ secrets.PYPI_TOKEN }}

  typescript-publish:
    name: Publish TypeScript SDK
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event_name == 'release' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
    needs: python-publish
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: pnpm
          registry-url: https://registry.npmjs.org/
      - name: Install pnpm
        run: corepack enable && corepack prepare pnpm@latest --activate
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install
      - name: Build SDK
        run: pnpm run build
      - name: Publish to npm
        run: pnpm publish --no-git-checks
        env:
          NODE_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}
```
